QUOTE: "`q.unsearched_corpora` must find no matching rows in corpora that `search` does not read. And `q.has_file_docs` must confirm the file-docs corpus exists." and "the strong wording ("definitive… do not retry or fall back to guessing") is used, but only after two checks."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the definitive wording is gated on a per-query check of which corpora `search` does not read (`unsearched_corpora`), not on a result shape alone. It also contrasts this with a blanket hedge.
